digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow — pytest job
propositions: The macOS pytest job (pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)) is the critical path in the Verified gate at 18.6m, with coverage collection consuming 15.4m of that time.

Coverage collection is redundant on macOS because the identical test selection and coverage floor (fail_under=70) are enforced identically by three ubuntu cells, making the macOS coverage tracing wasted work.

The macOS coverage flags (--cov=rebar --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered) must be made conditional on OS in the default-suite step to remove the duplicate tracing cost while retaining platform-compat testing.
The ubuntu cells must continue collecting coverage with the same flags and the test selection must remain byte-identical across platforms to preserve parity.
